lines.text: Difficulty starting is not a diagnosis or a character test.
Identify the obstacle, make one step visible, and know when to seek support.

items.text: Check the real deadline and consequences before choosing a small step.
Name the obstacle in ordinary words rather than choosing a diagnostic label.
Replace the project name with one action you can see yourself do.
Put the needed letter, file, or number within reach.
Reduce unrelated choices and interruptions if that helps you.
Ask for a specific prompt or shared start if wanted.

line.text: One thing at a time, chosen for you from what you already said mattered, and a plain "nothing needs you" on the days that is true.
